queries.name: acasala
queries.description: Returns assembly and production information by CMA.
queries.sql: SELECT vsibc.effect_stamp_image AS vin, substr(vsibc.eg_stamp_key, 1, 5) || '-' || substr(vsibc.eg_stamp_key, 7, 6) AS nr_carcaca, vsibc.assy_datetime AS data_hora_acasala, vsibc.assy_date AS dt_prod_chassi, vsiec.assy_date AS dt_prod_carcaca, vsibc.stamp_key AS cma FROM vic_s_int_bprd_ctl vsibc INNER JOIN vic_s_int_eprd_ctl vsiec ON vsiec.plan_stamp_image = substr(vsibc.eg_stamp_key, 1, 5) || '-' || substr(vsibc.eg_stamp_key, 7, 6) WHERE vsibc.stamp_key = :cma

queries.name: chassi
queries.sql: SELECT vib.plan_stamp_image AS vin, vib.stamp_key AS cma, vib.model_name AS designacao_comercial, vib.color_type AS tipo_cor, vib.color_code AS codigo_cor, substr(vib.modelvarit_code, 1, 4) AS modelo_chassi, substr(vib.plan_assyline, 3, 1) AS linha_montagem, substr(vib.assy_date, 1, 4) AS ano_fabricacao FROM vic_s_int_bprd_ctl vib WHERE vib.plan_stamp_image LIKE :vin

queries.name: motor
queries.description: Returns engine information by crankcase number.
queries.sql: SELECT vie.plan_stamp_image AS nr_carcaca, vie.stamp_key AS cma, vie.model_name AS modelo, substr(vie.plan_assyline, 3, 1) AS linha_montagem, vie.parent_part_no AS modelo_producao, substr(vie.parent_part_no, 1, 4) AS modelo_chassi FROM vic_s_int_eprd_ctl vie WHERE vie.plan_stamp_image LIKE :carcaca
